dataReuse.adaptation: Original bytes retained. Deterministic sorted range reduction; default Non_Joining. Every explicit scalar compared to source. No new executable third-party dependency.

algorithmsReused: Existing original HarfRust/Skrifa and original contextual unicode-bidi/script/grapheme clients; their previous fixed sources/licenses unchanged
Existing Unicode16 UAX14 implementation and platform ICU segmentation
Existing formal Paragraph Reader, Clipper2/Earcut geometry and admitted Native GPU paragraph renderer/compositor

referenceOnly.license: package.json declares MIT; standalone license notice not established in inspected tree. No implementation copied or installed.
referenceOnly.decision: Additive premeasured item/glue model needs a larger adapter for whole-line context-sensitive HarfRust reshaping. Independently implemented small measured-edge DP and bounded quadratic adjustment instead, preserving existing shaping and Reader. This is not a translated TeX engine.

newOwnedMath: Measured-edge dynamic programming and active-set bounded diagonal quadratic solver, independently implemented; no Adobe or third-party editor/renderer/timeline source copied.
